mode.title: What to scrape
mode.description: trending = Bilibili's current popular (热门) videos; search = keyword search; videos = specific video URLs or BV ids; user = uploads of specific channels (UP主).

keywords.title: Search keywords (mode: search)
keywords.description: One search per keyword. Chinese keywords give the best results on Bilibili, e.g. 原神 or 人工智能; English works too.

videos.title: Video URLs or IDs (mode: videos)
videos.description: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1xx411c7mD, BV1xx411c7mD or av170001. b23.tv short links aren't supported; open them and paste the full URL.

userIds.title: Channels (mode: user)
userIds.description: Channel UID (546195), channel URL (https://space.bilibili.com/546195) or exact channel name (老番茄).

maxItems.title: Max videos
maxItems.description: Max videos per keyword, per channel, or for trending. Each video is billed as one event.

includeComments.title: Include comments
includeComments.description: Add the video's hot comments (with replies) to each video. Without login Bilibili only shows the first page: about 3 top-level comments plus up to 20 replies to each, so expect up to ~60 comments per video. Each comment is billed as one event.

maxCommentsPerVideo.title: Max comments per video
maxCommentsPerVideo.description: Stop adding comments to a video after this many.

onlyNew.title: Only new videos (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only videos not returned by an earlier run with the same mode, keywords, search order, videos and channels. Schedule the actor (e.g. daily) for new-upload alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new videos. State is kept in the key-value store "bilibili-scraper-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Not needed normally. If Bilibili starts blocking requests (risk control, HTTP 412), try Apify Proxy.
